notes.title: Unsafe is Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are excited to announce our latest game "Unsafe", a horror coop game. We have been working on Unsafe for quite a few months now and we have finally decided to share it with you!

You can wishlist the game here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1756160/Unsafe/]Unsame on Steam[/url]

As we get closer to our early access release date, we will be posting more information / media from the game and keep you up to date with our progress. In the mean time, you can ask any questions you have on the Discussions page, we will do our best to answer!

We can't wait to see where this game goes with your help and suggestions!

Thank you
OnSkull Games

notes.title: Curious Cases is out! Gather your friends and play!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34697523/b7994f16869986a8f16532f53ee17bdf6e83a526.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

We are excited to announce our latest game, [b]Curious Cases[/b]! 

[b]Curious Cases[/b] is a remaster of the [b]multiplayer escape-room[/b] formula, taking you on an adventure, playing as Detective Moore to solve the [b]Mystery[/b] of the missing scientist! Exciting new puzzles and interactions await!. [b]Up to 6 people[/b] can play on [u][b]Desktop OR Virtual Reality[/b][/u] in Co-op or Competitive mode!

You can get it now for 20% OFF

 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1045080/Curious_Cases/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1045080/Curious_Cases/[/url]

Thank you,
    OnSkull Games
